sourceTitle: William the Conqueror Makers of History
description: "William the Conqueror" by Jacob Abbott is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The book explores the life and reign of William the Conqueror, the Duke of Normandy, focusing specifically on his rise to power and the circumstances that led to the Norman Conquest of England.
